message: Morning Christian. Today is Day 1 of 150. The plan is built and it's sitting in this dashboard — tap **Content plan** just under the greeting and it's all there: the spine, the pillars, the idea bank, the weekly rhythm, what to measure and when to kill a format.

The short version: you're not starting a fitness channel, you're starting a documented experiment. The spine is you going from marathon runner to sprinter in 150 days, with a filmed time trial at the end on 2 January. That's the story people come back for. Around it sit three repeatable series — ancient warrior diets, elite fitness standards, and myth tests — that give you the daily volume without inventing something new every morning.

Why that spine and not something else: four weeks ago you ran a marathon. Every adaptation in your legs right now is the wrong one for sprinting. That's not a weakness in the premise, it **is** the premise — and nobody else can make that video, because it's true about you.

One hard warning before you get excited. Sprinting off an endurance base is the fastest way to tear a hamstring in the sport. If that happens in week three, there is no channel — the arc dies with your leg. I've put a four-week ramp in today's list and the plan: nothing maximal until 3 September. Please don't skip it to get a good Day 1 clip.

Today's list in Todoist is setup, not posting. Five things, and the baseline films are the one you can't redo — you only get one Day 1. From tomorrow I'll write you a specific checklist each morning instead of generic reminders.
